title: Construct inquiry questions about a local issue
description: Construct focused questions with support to guide an inquiry into a local community topic.

title: Identify suitable sources of information independently
description: Identify and gather relevant information from more than one source to answer an inquiry question.

title: Identify different perspectives on a global challenge
description: Identify and explain different perspectives, including personal, local and global viewpoints on a shared issue.

title: Contribute actively and fairly to a shared team task
description: Divide tasks equitably within a group and listen constructively to team member contributions.

title: Evaluate the reliability and bias of online sources
description: Assess the reliability and potential bias of different digital and print sources when gathering evidence.
